name: lamp_post
note: Cast-iron street standard, 4 m tall, 0.24 m across the foot. Plinth skirt, base vase, astragal ring, entasis on the taper, capital collar, flared lantern seat. Envelope: max r 0.12, y +/-2.

name: lamp_post_near
note: same post, first-person framing - checks the base vase and capital

name: lamp_head_frame
note: Lantern frame: cast base plate with a drip rim, thin burner stem, bell-cast octagonal cap overhanging at the 0.25 eave, ball finial. The stem is deliberately thinner than the glazing so the glazing shows.

name: lamp_glazing
note: Octagonal glazed drum: base rim, panes leaning inward, top rail. Envelope: max r 0.175 at the base, y +/-0.225.

name: lamp_head_assembled
note: THROWAWAY PREVIEW, not shipped geometry: union outline of post + frame + glazing at their real world offsets (post y 2, head y 4.3). Judges the stack - cap overhang, plate reveal, glazing proportion.

name: lamp_head_assembled_near
note: THROWAWAY PREVIEW: the head alone - checks the cap/glazing junction, the vent gap under the eave and the reveal above the base plate.

name: lamp_full
note: THROWAWAY PREVIEW: whole lamp, ground to finial, at street distance.
